title: Polymyositis and dermatomyositis
summary: Polymyositis or dermatomyositis with one of: A proximal limb-girdle muscle weakness with documented assistive-device need or upper-extremity inability (A.1, A.2, or A.3); B impaired swallowing with aspiration; C impaired respiration from intercostal/diaphragmatic muscle weakness; D diffuse calcinosis with limitation of joint mobility or intestinal motility; or E repeated manifestations with constitutional symptoms and one marked functional limitation (E.1, E.2, or E.3).

children.criterion: Proximal limb-girdle (pelvic or shoulder) muscle weakness AND medical documentation of at least one of A.1, A.2, or A.3
Proximal limb-girdle (pelvic or shoulder) muscle weakness
One of A.1 (walker/bilateral canes), A.2 (one upper extremity inability + one-handed device), or A.3 (both upper extremities inability)
Documented medical need (see 14.00C6) for a walker, bilateral canes, or bilateral crutches (see 1.00C6d), or a wheeled and seated mobility device involving the use of both hands (see 1.00C6e(i))

Inability to use one upper extremity to independently initiate, sustain, and complete work-related activities involving fine and gross movements (see 14.00C7), AND documented medical need (see 14.00C6) for a one-handed, hand-held assistive device that requires the use of the other upper extremity, or a wheeled and seated mobility device involving the use of one hand (see 1.00C6e(ii))

Inability to use both upper extremities to the extent that neither can be used to independently initiate, sustain, and complete work-related activities involving fine and gross movements (see 14.00C7)
Impaired swallowing (dysphagia) with aspiration due to muscle weakness
Impaired respiration due to intercostal and diaphragmatic muscle weakness
Diffuse calcinosis with limitation of joint mobility or intestinal motility

Repeated manifestations of polymyositis or dermatomyositis, with at least two constitutional symptoms or signs (severe fatigue, fever, malaise, or involuntary weight loss) AND one of E.1, E.2, or E.3 at the marked level
Repeated manifestations with at least two constitutional symptoms (severe fatigue, fever, malaise, or involuntary weight loss)
Marked level limitation in one of E.1, E.2, or E.3
Marked limitation of activities of daily living
Marked limitation in maintaining social functioning
Marked limitation in completing tasks in a timely manner due to deficiencies in concentration, persistence, or pace
